استفعلن (form X)
# اِسْتَفْعَلْنَ (istafʕalna) /is.taf.ʕal.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اُسْتُفْعِلْنَ (ustufʕilna) /us.tuf.ʕil.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
# اِسْتَفْعِلْنَ (istafʕilna) /is.taf.ʕil.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَفْعَلَ (istafʕala)
